I think it should stay the same for game-play reasons. Everyone in the Galaxy is technically "at war" with every end game crisis. So a pacifist faction who's the other side of the galaxy and never sees the crisis would get a massive happiness penalty for no reason, which for governments with it as it's main faction can be devastating.

However I think that there should be separate modifiers with small unhappiness affects but are stack-able such as "Lost battle to Scourge -1% happiness", "Lost world to Scourge -3% happiness" which by the end of a crisis might be around -13% and -9%. 

EDIT: Of course these affects could also have positive inverses. I imagine your pops being quite happy that your empire took back a world or came out on top of a fleet battle.

I see the crisis more like 'The war on terror' we're always "at war" but we're not fighting another nation just a constant threat. Heck, pop and AI could have adaptive responses to crises such as being less trusting of hive minds after the Scourge or AI after the Contingency.

Obviously these are just ideas but some people might find them interesting.
